prompt: Rank by rate of ring-opening with hydroxide (fastest → slowest):

options.label: ethylene oxide > methyloxirane > 2,2-dimethyloxirane (steric hindrance slows it down)

concepts: steric effects on SN2 epoxide opening
explanation: Under base, Nu attacks the less hindered C via SN2-like TS. Adding methyl groups increases steric hindrance → slower reaction. Under acid, the trend reverses (the more substituted C bears more + character and attacks faster).
